title: Vermilion City & S.S. Anne
subtitle: Vs. Seeker, Old Rod, Bike Voucher, HM01 Cut, Thunder Badge

steps.text: Route 6: trainers on the way down, Oddish/Meowth/Pidgey in the grass, and a pond to fish in later.
Vermilion Pokémon Center: the woman at the counter-side gives you the Vs. Seeker. Use it on routes to rematch trainers (their teams grow each time).
Northwest house: the Fishing Guru gives the Old Rod (Magikarp everywhere).
Pokémon Fan Club (west-central building): listen to the Chairman's story to receive the Bike Voucher. Take it to Cerulean's Bike Shop for a free Bicycle.
House next to the Fan Club: trade a Spearow for Ch'Ding the Farfetch'd (holds Stick). Farfetch'd can learn Cut and Fly.
Board the S.S. Anne at the harbor with the S.S. Ticket. Every cabin has trainers and items; work through 1F, B1F and 2F.
Kitchen (B1F): check the trash cans; three hidden items including a Chesto Berry in the farthest can.
Rival battle 4 in the 2F corridor by the Captain's door. Pidgeotto Lv.19, Raticate Lv.16, Kadabra Lv.18, starter Lv.20. Kadabra's Confusion hurts Poison types.
Captain's quarters: rub the seasick Captain's back to get HM01 Cut. The ship leaves once you step off, so finish the cabins first.
Teach Cut to something expendable (Farfetch'd, Paras, Oddish) and cut the tree in front of Vermilion Gym.
Vermilion Gym: search the trash cans for the first switch, then the second is in an adjacent can. Wrong guess resets both.

Gym Leader Lt. Surge. Voltorb Lv.21, Pikachu Lv.18, Raichu Lv.24 (Shock Wave never misses). Ground types are immune: Diglett/Dugtrio from Diglett's Cave, Sandshrew, Geodude, Nidoran with Dig. Thunder Badge and TM34 Shock Wave.
